name: Bàoshí de Guàishòu Gōngzhǔ: Huòxīng Měishí zhī Lǚ
original_name: 暴食的怪獸公主: 惑星美食之旅
source:
You are cosmic mercenary and a chef from Earth whose life goal is to create the ultimate culinary experience. Unfortunately, you are also on the run from the galactic police after a former companion betrayed and framed you.

During a close shave with the authorities, you are saved by a literal monster. To your surprise, the monster turns into a beautiful pink-haired girl who claims to have sought you out for your cooking!

She (forcefully) offers to serve as your bodyguard in exchange for a place to live and a chance to try your delicious cooking every day.
Her crushing insistence and overwhelming power make it nigh impossible for you to refuse, so now you have to live together with this kaiju girl you just met!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2289720]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是一名来自地球的宇宙佣兵兼厨师，人生目标是创造极致的美食体验。不幸的是，昔日同伴背叛并诬陷了你，因此你正遭银河警察通缉。

在一次与当局的惊险周旋中，你被一只货真价实的怪兽所救。令你意外的是，怪兽变成了一名粉发美女，并声称自己是为了你的厨艺而找上门来！

她（强行）提出要当你的保镖，条件是让她有地方住，还能每天品尝你做的美味佳肴。她态度强硬、力量惊人，令你几乎无法拒绝；如今你只能与这位刚认识的怪兽女孩同居！

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2289720]Steam[/url]]
